## Purpose

Describe the problem, observation, or approved maintenance need this change addresses.

## Evidence / provenance

- Observation / Finding / Decision:
- Related issue or artifact:
- Human approval required: yes / no

## Change scope

- [ ] Stable Kernel
- [ ] Lab capability
- [ ] Product artifact
- [ ] Test / CI / release engineering
- [ ] Documentation only

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run po -- validate`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Relevant eval / experiment completed
- [ ] Regression risk reviewed

## Governance

- [ ] No Human Approval boundary is bypassed.
- [ ] No secret or credential is included.
- [ ] Repository Artifact remains the Source of Truth.
- [ ] Rollback / rejection path is understood.
